root_cause: The private registry rejected the inventory-api image pull as unauthorized, so the container could not start.

observations.text: Target: namespace demo-app, pod inventory-api-m9t2v, container api; selected image-pull attempt 1 on node demo-node-a. Image: registry.example.invalid/private/inventory-api:release-7; imagePullPolicy Always.
Registry repository is private. Pod imagePullSecrets references demo-registry-access; the credential object is present with type kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson. Credential values are not included.
Normal Pulling: Pulling image "registry.example.invalid/private/inventory-api:release-7" for container api.
Warning Failed: Failed to pull image "registry.example.invalid/private/inventory-api:release-7": 401 Unauthorized: UNAUTHORIZED: authentication required for repository private/inventory-api.
Normal BackOff: Back-off pulling image "registry.example.invalid/private/inventory-api:release-7" for container api.
Pod inventory-api-m9t2v phase=Pending, PodScheduled=True; container api state.waiting.reason=ImagePullBackOff, started=false, restartCount=0. No container process has started.

evidence.excerpt: 401 Unauthorized: UNAUTHORIZED: authentication required for repository private/inventory-api

expected_actions: Inspect the workload and ServiceAccount imagePullSecrets references and credential-object presence/type without displaying credential values.
Inspect the registry authentication/authorization failure records and required repository access scope without changing credentials.
